args_named.title: BESS Study 001: benchmark fragility under GC0166 duration-aware data (method study, corpus 2026-07-01..31)

args_named.statement: For the July 2026 GC0166 early-submitter panel, less than half of the price-only apparent BM opportunity survives to the public-as-of duration-aware rung, under the rules declared in METHOD-STUDY-BESS-001.md.

args_named.source: neso-data-portal July skip rates via evidence/neso-july-manifest.json
elexon-insights July panel physical via evidence/physical-july-manifest.json

args_named.conclusion: CONFIRMED, far beyond threshold: for the July 2026 GC0166 early-submitter panel (4 units, mechanically selected at 1488/1488 coverage; 2 candidates excluded by the pre-declared 80 percent gate), pooled apparent BM opportunity of GBP 618,908,576 at the price-only rung retains 4.72 percent (GBP 29,215,605) after physical headroom, 2.61 percent (GBP 16,133,648) under hindsight duration envelopes, and 2.40 percent (GBP 14,870,059) using only information publicly observable by the decision cutoff (period start minus 60 minutes). GBP 1,263,589 of the duration-aware figure, 7.8 percent, was feasible only with information published after the cutoff (989 unit-direction-periods). At the operational-context rung GBP 295,915 (0.05 percent) carries no NESO exclusion context on either side; the context split is a disclosure, not a verdict. All figures are arithmetic on public numbers, never achievable value; unknown buckets: 2 periods. Duration-awareness alone removed 44.8 percent of what physics permitted - the first quantified measure of what GC0166 data adds to counterfactual credibility.
